parts.name: Root
parts.description: The container. It holds the value and the open state, and it makes the native select for the form.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable id, from which the component makes its internal ARIA ids. Give one on a server.

props.name: value
props.description:
The selected key or keys: one key in the single mode, and an array in the multiple mode. You
can bind it with `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selection at the start, for when you give no `value`.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the selection. The component stops to write back to
`value`, and it reports only through `onChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the
parent does not send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:value` is the usual
case and it needs the write-back.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the selection changes.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state of the popover. You can bind it with `bind:open`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state at the start, for when you give no `open`.

props.name: controlledOpen
props.description: Give your own code full control of the open state. Read `controlledValue`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the open state changes. `details.cancel()` refuses the change.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection mode: 'single' permits one key, and 'multiple' permits more than one.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description:
Closes the popover after a selection. The default is true in the single mode, and false in the
multiple mode.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: The keys of the options that the user cannot select.

props.name: loop
props.description:
At the last option, the arrow keys move the focus to the first option, and at the first
option, to the last one.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the select. The trigger is disabled natively.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the trigger in the tab order, but the popover does not open and the value does not change.

props.name: required
props.description: Tells a form that it must have a value. The hidden control gets the native `required`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as invalid. The trigger gets `aria-invalid`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the hidden form control. Without it, the form does not send the value.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form that the hidden control belongs to, when the select is outside it.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description: The `autocomplete` of the hidden form control, for the browser autofill.

props.name: items
props.description:
The array of the items. The component reads the text of a selected key from it. Thus the
trigger shows the text while the popover is closed and the options are not in the DOM.

Each item needs a key in `id` or `value`, and a text in `textValue`, `label` or `name`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The text of the trigger while nothing is selected.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the select, for when there is no `Select.Label`.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives the select its name, in place of `Select.Label`.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The id of the element that describes the select, for example an error message.

props.name: children
props.description: The content: the label, the trigger and the popover.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the root element.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable reference to the context, for a composition of your own.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present when the focus in the select came from the keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present when the trigger or the list has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when a form must have a value here.

dataAttributes.name: data-select
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the root element.

dataAttributes.name: data-select-hidden
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the wrapper of the native select. It is hidden from assistive technology.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: The open state of the popover: "open" or "closed".

parts.name: Label
parts.description: The name of the field. It makes a label for the trigger, and it registers its id with the root.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the label.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-select-label
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the label element.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button that opens the list. It makes a button with role="combobox", and it shows the value.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content. As a snippet with one argument, it receives the render state: `open`,
`placeholder` and `disabled`. Put a `Select.Value` inside it.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the trigger.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while nothing is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when a form must have a value here.

dataAttributes.name: data-select-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the trigger element.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: The open state of the popover: "open" or "closed".

parts.name: Value
parts.description: The text of the selection inside the trigger, or the placeholder. It is part of the name of the field.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content. As a snippet with one argument, it receives the render state: `value`, `label` and
`placeholder`. Without it, the component shows the text of the selection.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The text while nothing is selected. It replaces the placeholder of the root.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while nothing is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-select-value
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the value element.

parts.name: Popover
parts.description: The floating panel that holds the list. It is Popover.Content with role="presentation".

props.name: children
props.description: The content: the list.

props.name: offset
props.description: The distance from the anchor element, on the main axis.

props.name: placement
props.description: The position against the anchor element.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Moves the panel to the opposite side when the space is not sufficient.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: The element that gives the limits of the position.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the popover container.

props.name: nonModal
props.description:
Makes the popover non-modal. The user can then operate the page, the focus does not stay in
the panel, and the page scrolls.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Closes the popover when the user clicks outside it.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Closes the popover when the user pushes the `Escape` key.

props.name: shouldCloseOnBlur
props.description: Closes the popover when the focus goes out of it. The default is true for a non-modal popover.

dataAttributes.name: data-select-popover
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the popover element.

parts.name: List
parts.description: The listbox inside the popover. It is ListBox.Root with the selection of the select, and it gets the focus when the popover opens.

props.name: items
props.description:
The items, for a list that the component makes from an array. Use it with a snippet that
receives one item. Give the same array to the root, so the trigger knows the text of each
key while the popover is closed.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the list. From an array of items, it receives one item.

props.name: emptyPlaceholder
props.description: The content while the list is empty. It can be a string or a Snippet.

props.name: getItemKey
props.description:
Reads the key of an item. This is the same value as the `id` of `ListBox.Item`.

You need it only with `virtualizer`. Without it, a Shift range is measured over the options in
the DOM. In a virtualized list, those are only the rows near the viewport, thus the range
stops at the scroll position of the user.

props.name: header
props.description:
The rows in the listbox above the items, for example an action row such as "Create …". They
are not in `children`, because from an array of items the component calls that snippet one
time for each item.

In a virtualized list, the keyboard does not go into these rows. There, the keys move through
the array of the items, and these rows are not in it.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the listbox container.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description:
Makes only the rows near the viewport, and not all of the rows.

The component obeys it only with `items`. The listbox must control the loop to cut it, thus a
list written as static children is never virtualized.

All of the rows must have the same height. This is what lets the component calculate the
scrollbar without a measurement of each row. The component measures the height from the first
row, but `rowHeight` replaces that measurement. Thus a list with your own styles needs no
fixed number.

The listbox element is the element that scrolls. Give it a maximum height and `overflow-y:
auto`. A long list without a virtualizer needs the same.

dataAttributes.name: data-select-list
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the list element.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: One option. It is ListBox.Item with an id that is unique across selects.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of this item. The component uses it for the selection.

props.name: textValue
props.description: The text for the typeahead. If you give none, the component reads it from the content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this item. The user cannot select it.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the item element.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the item.

dataAttributes.name: data-select-item
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the option element.

parts.name: ItemIndicator
parts.description: The mark of a selected option. It is in the DOM only while its option is selected, unless forceMount keeps it.

props.name: children
props.description: The content while the option is selected. The default is a check mark icon.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keeps the indicator in the DOM, for each selection state.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-select-item-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: The selection state of the option: "checked" or "unchecked".
